# SCI-PTC v0.1/r0.5 Candidate Review Cover

Status: scientific-owner review candidate; not frozen

Date: `2026-08-23`

This working-tree candidate implements approved
`WP1-OWNER-D001`--`WP1-OWNER-D009` without inspecting Citlali implementation.
It is a proposed successor to the frozen SCI-PTC v0.1/r0.4 authority at commit
`55efd8a54464636a24e621f6d1b60486d235b20e`.

The package `README.md`, `SCIENTIFIC_OWNER_FREEZE_R0.4.md`, and canonical PDFs

- the current candidate author sources under `src/`;
- `AUTHOR_DRAFT_DECISIONS.md` and regenerated `CROSSWALK.md`;
- separately marked PDFs under `pdf/r0.5-candidate/`; and
- the exact author packet and r0.4-to-r0.5 change map in the six-package audit

## Owner-review gates

Before freeze, the scientific owner must:

1. supply the exact detector-wise time-axis location estimator and its
   boundary rule for `lambda_g`;
2. accept or revise the mask-aware, detector-right, time-local coefficient
   realization in candidate Equation 8; and
3. review the complete candidate packet and issue a separate approval/freeze
   decision.

Until those gates are complete, r0.4 remains the scientific authority. No
finding closure, implementation conformity, numerical validation, achieved
performance, science qualification, production readiness, or MAP
availability is claimed by this candidate.
